y1: Jesus heard the sad news that John the Baptist was killed because of King Herod. He got into a boat and went to a quiet place.
y2: But many people followed Him on foot. When Jesus saw them, He had compassion on them and healed the sick.
y4: When evening came, the disciples said, “Send the people away so they can go and buy food.” Jesus said, “You give them something to eat.” But there were only five loaves of bread and two fish.
y5: Jesus looked up to heaven, gave thanks, broke the bread, and gave it to them. There were five thousand men alone, everyone ate until they were full, and twelve baskets were left over!
y7: At night, the disciples' boat was struggling because of the wind and waves. Early in the morning, Jesus came toward them walking on the water.
y8: The disciples thought He was a ghost and cried out. Jesus said, “Cheer up! It is I, do not be afraid!”
y10: Peter said, “Lord, if it is You, command me to come to You on the water.” When Jesus said, “Come,” Peter also walked on the water!
y11: But when he saw the wind, he was afraid and began to sink. “Lord, save me!” Jesus immediately reached out His hand and caught him. Those in the boat worshiped Him and said, “You are truly the Son of God!”
verse: “Cheer up! It is I, do not be afraid!”
prayer: Jesus, I praise You for feeding so many people with a little bread and fish, and for walking on the water. Let me give You the small things I have, too. When I am afraid, let me look at You instead of the wind, and when I sink, hold my hand. I pray in the name of Jesus Christ. Amen.
d0: have compassion. It means feeling sad when you see someone else's pain and wanting to help them. Jesus had compassion on the people.
d1: bread. It is the round, flat bread that people ate back then. There were five loaves of bread and two fish.
d2: give thanks. It is praying to thank God for giving us food. Jesus took the bread and gave thanks.
d3: water. It is the top of the water where you don't sink. Jesus walked on the water.
d4: ghost. It is a scary, strange shape that looks like something is there. The disciples thought Jesus was a ghost.
d5: worship. It means bowing down before God to honor Him. The disciples worshiped Jesus.
